safety.note: Morphine-dependent rats showed peripheral withdrawal (diarrhoea, weight loss) from 0.3 mg/kg; central signs limited to teeth chattering at 3 mg/kg.

safety.note: Patients had more abdominal pain and diarrhoea on naldemedine, with few central withdrawal events, matching the rats' peripheral-only withdrawal.
safety.short: GI adverse reactions, as rats showed
